outcome.Summary: Created package `tmpl` with `Render(src, data) (string, error)` in tmpl/tmpl.go (stdlib only): copies text verbatim, treats `{{{{` as a literal `{{`, parses `{{ name | filter | filter:"arg" }}` tags with whitespace-insensitive scanning of names and `.field` dotted lookups into nested `map[string]any`, formats values per spec (strings as-is, numerics via fmt.Sprint, bool as true/false, nil/missing as ""), and implements upper/lower/trim/default/truncate (rune-aware with U+2026)/html filters with proper argument-count and integer validation. Errors (unknown filter, missing/extra arg, bad truncate arg, unterminated/empty tag, bad name, non-map indexing with full name) return an error and empty output. Added tmpl/tmpl_test.go covering verbatim/escaped braces, all value formats, nested lookup, all filters including escapes, error cases, and mixed rendering; `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes.
